details: 792 kernel frame byte matches: 4 packed orders x 6 sizes (1x1,2x2,5x3,7x5,8x6,17x9) x 11 contraction-free option sets x 3 frames (noise, colour ramps, edges/constant planes); 726 frames changed
648 kernel frame byte matches with typical and extreme float options, gated to linux-x64; 615 changed
16 thread-invariance cases (default, -filter_threads 1, -filter_threads 8 native outputs equal and equal to the kernel)
400 linear and graph plan matches with conversions (-cpuflags 0, scalar)
16 replay streams and 12 activation actor runs
304 CLI rawvideo/framecrc matches with and without -ss/-t on media -vf/-filter_complex and timed producer, activation and pull
72 refusals before output (18 forms x 4 backends; native status pinned: 13 fail natively, 5 accepted natively)

unsupported: expression-valued and SI-suffixed float option values (native evaluates them)
enable= timeline and runtime commands (native supports both)

notes: Node 24.22.3 from /opt/node24 (sandbox default was Node 22). Bootstrap npm,submodule,reference took 177 s; baseline typecheck, lint, boundaries and the video registry test took 56 s and passed.

The linux-x64 gate is a precaution: no macOS run was made. A JS simulation of contracted multiply-adds over a 256x256x86 RGB grid changed 0 pixels for every portable option set and 317 to 54024 pixels for 6 of the 9 gated sets.
Two kernel mutations (unrounded spill-map sum; rounding instead of truncation) were each caught by the differential file (7 and 6 failing tests).
Formats returns native pixel_fmts in declared order; all four have storage, so no negotiated pick is refused. Non-packed-alpha sources negotiate argb as natively.
